description: Type-C Rechargeable AA Battery: Portronics Lithius Cell comes with a built-in USB Type-C port for fast, convenient charging—no external charger required. Just plug and power up anytime. High-Capacity Performance: Equipped with a 1.5V, 1480mAh (2220mWh) lithium cell, delivering consistent voltage and long runtime for high-drain devices like cameras, remotes, and gaming controllers. Fast Charging & Stable Output: Supports DC 5V/0.5A input and DC 1.5V/2A output, ensuring quick recharges and stable power delivery for wireless keyboards, torches, and electric brushes. Enhanced Safety Features: Built-in over-current and over-discharge protection extends battery life and safeguards your gadgets from damage during use or charging. Low Self-Discharge Technology: Maintains up to 80% charge even after months of non-use, making it a reliable, eco-friendly alternative to disposable AA batteries. Multi-Functional Compatibility: Ideal for wireless mouse and keyboard, remote control car, lamps, alarm clocks, torches, and other AA-powered household or office gadgets.
